userBindings.summary: Chrome and Edge built-in shortcuts can't be rebound (S5, S6), so Prism always sends the defaults. Only extension commands are user-assignable (chrome://extensions/shortcuts, edge://extensions/shortcuts); Edge also has one user-set split-screen shortcut (Settings > Accessibility, S6).

locations.note: Extension command bindings only, at extensions.commands (and account_values.extensions.commands when synced). Read-only; content never copied. Present on this PC (S9).
Same shape for Edge extension commands (S9). The split-screen shortcut pref was not present (default) on this PC.

userBindings.entryShape: extensions.commands is an object keyed '<platform>:<keys>' (e.g. 'windows:Ctrl+Shift+Y'); each value is { command_name, extension, global }.
userBindings.keyNameMap: Chrome accelerator strings ('Ctrl+Shift+Y', 'Comma', 'Period', 'MediaPlayPause') map 1:1 to Prism chord names; 'Command' is Mac-only.
userBindings.readMode: Not needed for the built-ins. Useful only if Prism ever ships an extension command (e.g. a global 'grant activeTab' key): read the user's chosen chord from extensions.commands, read-only, never written.

layouts.rationale: Mirrors browser.md 5.1: live tab keys on top, media at the right edge, back/reload/forward then reopen/download/close (hold) at the bottom; left dial = tabs/page, right dial = scrub/speed.
Mirrors browser.md 5.2: three tab keys plus media on top, back/reload/download/SAFE below; dials tabs, page, scrub, speed with their strip readouts.

conflicts: Developer tools: S1 says Ctrl+Shift+J opens Developer Tools; S3 maps Ctrl+Shift+J to the Console panel and Ctrl+Shift+I to DevTools; S2 (Edge) lists Ctrl+Shift+I. The pack uses F12, which all three list.
Ctrl+M: Edge mutes the tab (S2); Chrome has no default (S1, S3). Modeled as the Edge-only verb tab.muteKey; Chrome uses the extension.
Ctrl+Shift+L: Edge = paste and search/go (S2); Chrome 155 = collapse/expand the vertical tab strip (S3). Not used by the pack.
Ctrl+Shift+K: Edge duplicates the tab (S2); no Chrome default. Edge-only verb.
Ctrl+Shift+O: Chrome opens the Bookmark Manager (S1), Edge opens Favorites (S2): same idea, not used on keys.
Ctrl+Shift+PgUp/PgDn (move tab), Shift+Esc (task manager), Ctrl+Shift+A (tab search) are in S1/S3 but not on Edge's list (S2).
gaps: Edge parity for Chromium-core chords S2 omits (move tab, task manager, tab search, tab groups, reading mode): needs a 2-minute in-app check in Edge 155 (see each verb's verify).
Edge window-title suffix (for site title fallbacks) not observed: Edge wasn't running during the probe.
Chrome/Edge PWAs and app windows also run as chrome.exe/msedge.exe: there is no tab strip there. A future exclude rule could use the absence of the ' - Google Chrome' title suffix (S10).
Never match on window class: Chrome_WidgetWin_1 is shared by every Electron app (VS Code, Discord, Orca).
pageKeys step size and pageScroll readout are not measured yet.
Shortcut chords assume a US layout for punctuation (Equal, Minus); vk mode sends the key, not the character.
notes: Reserved shortcuts (S4): Ctrl+T, Ctrl+N, Ctrl+Shift+N, Ctrl+W, Ctrl+Shift+W, Ctrl+Shift+T, Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+Shift+Tab, Ctrl+PgUp/PgDn always reach the browser, even on sites with their own shortcuts, except in browser fullscreen (F11), where everything but F11 goes to the page first. Every other chord here (Ctrl+F, Ctrl+K, Ctrl+D, Ctrl+L...) can be captured by a page.
Lite tier: when a verb's module binding can't run (extension missing or not connected), the engine uses the first altBinding that can (a chord, which needs the browser in front).

chrome and edge are variant child contexts of browser. They only unlock browser-specific verbs; the generator should reuse the browser layout for them. Site packs that extend this pack inherit the '*' verbs; Chrome-/Edge-only verbs need the engine to also evaluate this pack's variant contexts.

Candidate verbs left out (all sourced, low deck value): Ctrl+6..8 tabs, Ctrl+9 last tab, End (page bottom), Alt+Shift+X / Alt+Shift+Z (next / previous tab group, Chrome), Ctrl+N new window, Ctrl+G/Ctrl+Shift+G find next/prev, Ctrl+P print, Ctrl+S save page, Ctrl+U view source, Ctrl+Shift+J console, Ctrl+Shift+B bookmarks bar, Ctrl+Shift+O bookmarks, Ctrl+Shift+Delete clear data, Alt+F menu, F7 caret browsing, Alt+Shift+C / Alt+Shift+W (add tab to group / close group).
